10579401.ch: 啊啊啊，我的{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}... 今日{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}让我痛失至亲，吾虽弱小但来日也定让{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}感同身受，皇天在上，我以自身道行起誓，此生定诛杀你！

10580001.en: {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}, hold on! I understand it's all {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}'s fault. Being a parent is no easy feat, so please don't hurt my {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}. I'm begging you!
10580001.ch: {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}且慢！ {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}多有不懂事，但还请看在为人父母不易之上，请别伤害我的{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}。求求您

10580101.en: This fool really gets on my nerve, but I can tell you're speaking from the heart. Fine, I'll let it go this time, but make sure it doesn't happen again.
10580101.ch: 此子虽是另我不快，但看你态度诚恳。此事翻篇，但下不为例。

10580301.en: If you can't back up your talk with action, don't go around boasting. Keep that in mind for you afterlife!
10580301.ch: 行走八荒若实力不足，就别招摇过市。这句话下辈子记得吧！

10580401.en: Noooo, my {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}... Why, {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}?! You think being a powerful cultivator gives you the right to act like a bully? Well, don't underestimate the determination of a parent!
10580401.ch: 啊啊啊，我的{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}... {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}何苦咄咄逼人！ 仗着修为之高便可为所欲为吗，千万不要低估为人父母的决心！

10588000.en: You sense that {name|B} is in danger by means of {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}'s Divine Thought and the enemy in question is {name|A}. Do you want to step in?
10588000.ch: 通过留在{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}身上的神念感应到{name|B}遭遇了危险，敌人是{name|A}，是否出面干涉

10588001.en: [{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}, hold on! I understand my {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051} has rubbed you the wrong way. I'll give you {0} as a peace offering. Show some mercy, will you?]
10588001.ch: 「{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}且慢！我的{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}今日多有得罪，我用这{0}物品换取这次手下留情，还望能给鄙人几分薄面。」

10588101.en: [...Although there's bad blood between {name|B} and me, I'll let it slide for your sake. Tell {gender|B} to get lost now!]
10588101.ch: 「虽然{name|B}跟我有些仇怨，但看在你的份上，这次就放其一马。还不让{gender|B}快滚！」

10588201.en: [Fine, I'll let this slide, {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}. You can go now. I'll see you later. Remember, make peace and work hard on your cultivation.]
10588201.ch: 「好了，{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}这次不跟你计较此事了你也回去吧，我过段时间再来看你。以后少与人争斗，修炼上切不可懈怠。」

10588301.en: [Hmph, {name|B}'s my sworn enemy! I'm not going to let {name|B} get away with it no matter what!]
10588301.ch: 「哼！{name|B}跟我有不共戴天之仇，就是将整个八荒送与我也休想让我放过此人！」

10588401.en: [Since you insist, {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}, I'd like to see what you're made of, {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}!]
10588401.ch: 「既然{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}执意如此，他日倒要领教领教{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}手段！」

10589001.en: [How could you even think of doing that? Nobody's going to mess with my {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051} while I'm around!]
10589001.ch: 「放肆！我倒要看看何人敢动我的{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}！」

10589101.en: [{name|C}, my bad! I'll let {name|B} go right now. Please forgive me, Immortal!]
10589101.ch: 「{name|C}！小人有眼无珠，这就放了{name|B}，还望仙长海涵！」

10589201.en: [Are you alright, {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}? {gender|A} did the right choice, otherwise... hmph. Alright, you can go now. I'll see you later. Remember, make peace and work hard on your cultivation.]
10589201.ch: 「{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}，你还好吧，还算{gender|A}识趣，否则…哼。你先回去吧，我过段时间再来看你。以后少与人争斗，修炼上切不可懈怠。」

10589401.en: [You lay a hand on my people, huh? I'll make sure your life is a living hell if I get a hold of you!]
10589401.ch: 「敢动我的人！他日落到我手中定叫你生不如死！」

10590001.en: [{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}, hold on! I understand my {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051} has rubbed you the wrong way. This is all because I didn't discipline my {callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051} properly. Being parent is no easy feat, so please, let {gender|B} go.]
10590001.ch: 「{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}手下留情！我的{callIgnore|C|B|1050|1051}今日多有得罪，全因我管教无方，望前辈体谅我等为人父母之心，大人大量饶{gender|B}一命。」

10590101.en: [Fine, I'll let this slide for your sake. Now go before I change my mind!]
10590101.ch: 「也罢，这次看在你的份上我就饶其一回。在我改变注意前还不快走！」

10590201.en: [You're lucky this time, you know? Go now! Do us both a favor and make peace with people. I'll be seeing you around.]
10590201.ch: 「这位前辈饶你一命还不快走，以后少与人争斗，我过段时间再来看你。」

10590301.en: [Hmph, {name|B}'s my worst enemy. I don't care who's got {name|B}'s back. This person's not getting away with this!]
10590301.ch: 「哼！{name|B}与我仇深似海，就是神仙出手也休想让我放过此人！」

10590401.en: I still have a long way to go in my cultivation... You're a brilliant fighter, {callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}. Have you ever thought you would be a parent too and have to deal with the situation I'm having...
10590401.ch: 「都怪我修为浅薄…{callIgnore|C|A|1050|1051}纵然神通广大，难道不怕他日也操这为人父母之心吗…」

10592000.en: Today, you returned to your sect and found a person outside the gate talking to two peer cultivators there.
10592000.ch: 这天你回到宗门领地，却见一人立于山门之外，正与你的两名同门说话。

10592001.en: Our sect welcomes talented candidates. However, your constitution is so special that it renders your spiritual roots feeble. You would find many things difficult even if they were effortless to others, not to mention growing into a master cultivator.
10592001.ch: 我宗收录门人十分严格，一律择优录取。你因先天体质缺陷之故，导致灵根十分软弱。旁人一蹴而就之事，在你可能十分艰难。遑论修成道法，成为大能。

10592002.en: Diligence can make up for everything! Maybe my condition is poor indeed, but I will remedy it by other means!
10592002.ch: 苦心人，天不负！我先天不强，可以后天补救！

10592003.en: Records in our sect showed that you are Nil Root Constitution. Its remedy requires unimaginable effort.
10592003.ch: 据我宗记载，你身负的乃是三阴绝脉体质，后天补救，那是十分艰难的。

10592004.en: The person was declined after imploring many times, and could only leave in low spirits.
10592004.ch: 这名修仙者再三求恳，仍未获收录，最终满怀失望的离开了。

10592005.en: That ridiculous visitor even told us that he lives outside <r>the main city of Hua Feng</r>. Nil Root Constitution is impossible to correct, and senior, you seem to be too polite when talking to the whimsical one.
10592005.ch: 这人也是好笑，还告诉我们他会暂时结庐住在<r>华封州主城外</r>。三阴绝脉体，无可补救。后天努力，不过痴人说梦罢了。师兄，你说得可真委婉啊。

10592006.en: The constitution is very, no, extremely rare. It must be torturing for a person who has decided to cultivate, and fate is cruel to our visitor.
10592006.ch: 三阴绝脉，万中无一，他矢志修仙，心中承受的痛苦会比任何人都多吧？也是一个可怜人。

10592007.en: If I were you, I'd speak out all I thought and drive the person off. No need to waste time on that.
10592007.ch: 要是我，直接就把话说明白然后赶走此人，我最耐不住废话。

10592009.en: You entered the Manual Pavilion, followed by a rogue cultivator. Seeing the person reading the books carefully, the manager comes here.
10592009.ch: 你进入琅琊阁后，一名散修从后进来，然后细细研读阁中书籍。阁中主管见状，便走了过来。

10592010.en: Greetings. I noticed your love for reading, and I believe that such a knowledgeable person would be a professional librarian at the Pavilion. Are you interested in it?
10592010.ch: 朋友，你的博览群书，胸中饱含古今修仙之法。正适合进入我阁成为一名编修，敢问你可愿意？

10592012.en: Yes. It would be a suitable position for someone who knows so much but could never... Well. It's just my suggestion, and it's up to you to decide.
10592012.ch: 不错。如此一来正好扬长避短，既发挥朋友你的长处，又不必……嗯，这是我单方面的想法，当然还要征得你的同意才行。

10592013.en: ...Thank you. But I want to practice your manuals recently!
10592013.ch: ……多谢你的好意。不过我最近的目标是要练成你这里的秘籍呢！

10592014.en: Pavilion owner, would you like to deliver the rare manual to my residence near <r>the main city of Hua Feng</r>, if you please? I must go now.
10592014.ch: 老板，麻烦你将那本稀有的秘籍送到我的住处可好？我目前<r>结庐住在华封州主城附近</r>，先走了。

10592016.ch: 嘿嘿，这家伙还挺硬气的。

10592017.en: Oh, you know that one? I seem to have found him visiting the Manual Pavilion many times recently.
10592017.ch: 咦？你知道这人？好像最近老看见他来到琅琊阁啊。

10592018.en: He was born with feeble spiritual roots but is determined to be a cultivator and act against fate. I guess our boss's suggestion, though out of good intentions, hurt the visitor's pride.
10592018.ch: 这人灵根软弱，无法修炼。但偏偏要跟老天较劲，定要成为一名修仙者。刚刚老板虽是一番好意，只怕却是伤了这家伙的心了。

10592019.en: Sigh. It's not bad at all to be a librarian in the Manual Pavilion. He would lead a peaceful life after that.
10592019.ch: 唉，进入琅琊阁当一名编修可有什么不好的？从此生活安定，多好啊。

10592020.en: Alas. Cultivators are always busy fighting and scheming against each other. I am tired of all these matters.
10592020.ch: 唉，修仙者大都尔虞我诈，勾心斗角，长久陷在这个圈子之中，也不禁有些累了。

10592021.en: It would be good to have a herb garden, perhaps. I could tend the herbs there or have a drink beside it, or watch the stars fading or the sun setting. A wonderful life.
10592021.ch: 如今我倒想弄一个药园，忙时修篱种药，闲来小酒清茶。早饮星辰露，晚看夕阳斜。如此一来，岂不惬意？

10592022.en: My dream is something else. I want to be a master cultivator and save innocent people from demons and evildoers. This would be the path I always longed for, but my constitution doesn't allow me to practice advanced martial arts.
10592022.ch: 我却不是这么想。若我身负修为定要成为一方仙长，斩妖除魔，捍卫正道。这样才不负修仙者的名头。只可惜我身怀三阴绝脉之阴气，无法进一步修炼高深的功法。

10592023.en: Well? Seems you haven't given up yet?
10592023.ch: 哦？这么说来，你还没放弃？

10592024.en: To your surprise, I haven't; and I will not. I'll find the way to remedy my Nil Root Constitution no matter how difficult it would be.
10592024.ch: 见笑了。我是不会放弃的。天上地下，走遍八荒，我都要找到拔除三阴绝脉体的法子。

10592025.en: I'm not mocking you. The right to choose a way to follow lies in our own hands, not anyone else's.
10592025.ch: 我没笑你啊。一个人要怎么走，走什么样的路只有这个人自己能决定。旁人根本无从置喙。

10592026.en: What's more, our world also needs an ambitious and righteous cultivator like you. And I'm always here waiting for your good news. Let's have a drink after you find a way to cure your constitution and begin your cultivation.
10592026.ch: 而且八荒正需要你这样心存猛志，性情忠厚的仙侠。我可是等着你呢，等你拔除三阴绝脉体，成为修仙者后，我们再共饮一杯。

10592027.en: Sure! I will be living near <r>the main city of Hua Feng</r> the next month, and I have prepared drinks for it. We'll toast my success someday!
10592027.ch: 当然！我打算下个月便到<r>华封州主城外结庐暂住</r>。到时我先在家中备好酒水。等我修为有成，你我再谋一醉。

10592031.en: What do you want? How could you know the name?
10592031.ch: 你想做什么？你是从哪里知道这个地方的？

10592032.en: I found it after scanning through many secret tomes. It is said to be a place transformed from Pangu's shin bone after he split the sky and the earth.
10592032.ch: 我翻了好多好多秘典，才查到这个地方的。听说为盘古开天辟地后一截胫骨所化。

10592033.en: His marrow and blood continued to emit heat and turned the place into a crucial point in forming lands. It is like a great forge that reshapes everything, including... my constitution?
10592033.ch: 盘古的骨髓和真血继续发挥余热，这地方便成为当时塑造八荒一方土壤的关键节点。这是一个大“烘炉”，能塑造一切，包括……体质？

10592034.en: Are you crazy? It is a place with scorching air and freezing ice, and the lightning bolts there will smash you to smithereens.
10592034.ch: 你疯了吗？那个地方终年高热，但还会结成玄冰，天空会不断闪出惊雷，击打着地上的一切。你进去后只会被打成渣滓。

10592035.en: That is, every trace of your existence will be wiped out!

10592036.en: You know something about it! So the legends are true, right?
10592036.ch: 你果然知道这个地方。那么说，的确有这个地方了？

10592037.en: Just put the thought aside. The Supreme Forge is never for ordinary people. There must be other means to cure your Nil Root Constitution.
10592037.ch: 你……你别乱想。那个地方岂是寻常人能进入的？一定还有很多方法可以根除三阴绝脉体的。

10592038.en: I will, and am glad to, try my best to seize the hope, no matter how impossible it seems.
10592038.ch: 只要有一线希望，再艰难再危险，我都愿意去试，都会去试。

10592041.en: Sigh. I remember you; I have met you before. Hope you would not mind my poor performance.
10592041.ch: 唉，我记起来了。之前曾在外遇见你。让你见笑了。

10592042.en: I was born with a special constitution, and the ancient books told me that it was Nil Root Constitution. It would block the circulation of Qi in the body and render the spiritual roots feeble. Therefore, persons affected by it would be unable to practice martial or spiritual arts.
10592042.ch: 在下自小体质异于常人，查看古籍方知这是三阴绝脉体质。怀有这体质的人不但脉气都被阴寒阻绝，灵根亦十分软弱，完全无法修炼一般灵技功法。

10592043.en: But I still want to amend the situation. If everyone can begin their cultivation, why can't I?
10592043.ch: 尽管如此，我还是很想改变自己。我和其他人没区别，别人能修炼，我也能。

10592044.en: You're right! The constitution has troubled me from my birth, but I believe it's possible to remedy it with my efforts.
10592044.ch: 你说得太对了！这恼人的体质虽是先天带来，焉知我不能通过努力克服排除？

10592045.en: Would you like to talk to me more frequently? I'll be living near the city the next month.
10592045.ch: 如果可以，能否请你多来与我说说话，来月我就来到城外结庐暂住。

10592046.en: Hey, I know you! I've seen you before, right?
10592046.ch: 啊，我记起来了！之前我好像曾经遇见过你！

10592047.en: Well, maybe my poor performance impressed you. I am very interested in cultivation techniques, and I want to be one of the cultivators someday.
10592047.ch: 我的丑态都给你看见了，呵呵。在下十分钟爱修仙之术，生平立志成为修仙者。

10592048.en: Well, I'll be living near this city the next month. If possible, please come to talk to me more frequently. Your words will benefit me a lot.
10592048.ch: 对了，来月我便会到这城外附近结庐暂住。若不嫌弃，日后还请多加交流，好使我有所裨益。

10592049.en: You see {name|B} trudging along a mountain path with a heavy sword dragged behind. He leaves a notch on the cliff there every time upon reaching the mountain's top.
10592049.ch: 只见{name|B}拖着一口重剑在山道上艰难移动，他每一次将长剑拖到山顶就在山壁刻下一笔。

10592050.en: I'm exercising my strength. A manual told me that I can improve my cultivation with it as well.
10592050.ch: 我在锻炼自己的气力。我记得一本秘籍上说这样修炼也能增加修为呢。

10592051.en: It may seem clumsy, but maybe I can make my breakthrough to Foundation someday if I practiced it again and again. However, I don't know when will the day come.
10592051.ch: 这法子虽笨，但只要持之以恒，也许有朝一日，我能突破瓶颈而至筑基境呢？唉，只是那个日子还看不到头罢了。

10592052.en: I'll try my best to cure my Nil Root Constitution. I will be a master cultivator.
10592052.ch: 我会继续寻找方法根除自己的三阴绝脉体。我会成为修仙者，一代大能。

10592053.en: {name|B} inhales and cheers up again. He leaves another fresh notch on the cliff with a shard and continues to climb up with the sword.
10592053.ch: {name|B}说完吸了口气，重新振奋精神，然后拿起一块尖石在石壁上再刻下一记号，这才拖着巨剑继续登山。

10592054.en: Sorry, here is for cultivators only. Please leave.
10592054.ch: 此处禁止非修仙者进入，请移步别处。

10592055.en: ...I just want to have a visit.

10592057.en: Well, I am also a cultivator...

10592058.en: No. Your spiritual roots are abnormal, and could not practice advanced martial arts. You will never be a cultivator.
10592058.ch: 你不是。你的灵根异于常人，无法修习深奥精妙的功法。不要奢望成为一名修仙者了。

10592060.en: Leave here before I drive you off.
10592060.ch: 这就离开吧，不要逼我用强。

10592062.en: Well, never mind. It seems that I am special - so special that you see through me at first glance among so many cultivators, right?
10592062.ch: 没事没事，你看这家伙一眼就能把我的底细看明白了，由此看来我在众多修仙者中还是很特别的，不是吗？

10592063.en: I'll leave here today and will return as a competitor, not a visitor. See you soon!
10592063.ch: 今日先不来参观了，日后我修炼有成，直接来这里参赛好了！

10592064.en: I want to settle down in a peaceful place, with a bamboo hut, a clutch of chicks, and... you. Do you know what I mean?
10592064.ch: 我想找个清静的地方，在那搭一间竹庐，养一窝小鸡，从此以后我们就在那生活。你……明白我的意思吗？

10592065.en: Well?! Eh, I'm sorry... I haven't thought of it.
10592065.ch: 啊？！对不起……我还没考虑过这些。

10592066.en: Maybe you could... think about it now?

10592067.en: I'd like to make another try.

10592068.en: I only see you traveling here and there every day. Don't you feel tired? Sometimes it may be better to accept the arrangement of our fate than to change it.
10592068.ch: 每天都巴巴的四处奔走，不累吗？有些东西是注定的，是命，轮不到我们做主的。

10592069.en: You're right, but I still hope that I could exhaust every possibility to change my fate someday, even if it means I need to travel to every corner of the world.
10592069.ch: 你说得都对，但我还是盼望自己能够走遍天下每一个角落，找遍每一个能够为改变自己的方法。试遍每一个有机会改变自己的方法。

10592070.en: And before that, I will never surrender to my fate.
10592070.ch: 在那之前，我都不认这个“命”。

10592071.en: I'm ready to give up all I have and follow you, but why are you so obsessed with your lofty dream?! Do as you wish!
10592071.ch: 我都甘愿为你放弃一切，你怎么就爱为这些虚无缥缈的东西拼命呢？！你好自为之吧！

10592073.en: Seeing {name|B} cannot be convinced, the cultivator left the spot. {name|B} gazes into the far distance and the road ahead, seeming tired.
10592073.ch: 此名修仙者无法说服{name|B}，当场拂袖而去。{name|B}目视远方，看着无尽的长路，眼神中不禁透出一丝疲色。

10592074.en: Thank you. Actually, I am also uncertain about whether my endeavor will bring me good results.
10592074.ch: 多谢你。其实我这样不太明白这样一直坚持是不是真的好。

10592075.en: But I don't want to give up now...

10592076.en: You entered {name|B}'s residence and found a pile of manuals, as well as notes taken from them. You also noticed a piece of paper on the desk listing dozens of methods to cure the Nil Root Constitution. Some of them have been crossed out.
10592076.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，只见里面放满了修炼秘籍，还有大叠阅读心得。而书案上放着一张白纸，上面分列数十条排除三阴绝脉体的方法，当中有部分已被划去。

10592077.en: {name|B} is standing on a hill and looking into the distance. A cultivator rides on something and glides through the air in a moment.
10592077.ch: {name|B}站在一处高冈上，正在眺望远方。此时一名修仙者御物横空而过，眨眼去远。

10592078.en: I occasionally see cultivators riding in flying swords. I always wonder where will they go.
10592078.ch: 天上偶尔会有些修仙者御剑而过。这时我就会想，他们是要去哪呢？

10592079.en: If only someday I could ride on a sword and fly to wherever I want!
10592079.ch: 要是有朝一日，我也能这样凌空御剑，那该有多好啊。

10592080.en: Well, I would go to the most perilous land and bring the people peace with my sword!
10592080.ch: 唔，我应该会驾驭宝剑，斩妖除魔，保卫一方安宁！

10592081.en: And what is the feeling of riding a sword in the sky? It must be wonderful, right?
10592081.ch: 不过，其实只要能这样御剑飞在天上，就已经很惬意，很舒服了。

10592082.en: Sigh. If someday I could become a cultivator!
10592082.ch: 哎呀，真想当一名真正的修仙者啊！

10592084.en: You see a cultivator instructing a young man to command his energy. The young man holds two fingers together and points into the air, and the next moment, a sharp flow hits on the monolith in front and cracks it in a deafening noise.
10592084.ch: 只见一名修仙者正在口说手比指点一名少年使用灵力，少年则骈指凝神，向虚空一点，一股气流穿空而去，击中前方巨石。巨石因此发出轰鸣，从而龟裂。

10592085.en: {name|B} watches them silently and tries to do it following the cultivator's instruction. However, nothing happens on the monolith; his move only sways the willow branches before him.
10592085.ch: {name|B}呆在不远处看过这一切后，也依着修仙者的传授发出灵力。然而巨石并未开裂，只有面前垂柳受他指风带动，微微摇曳。

10592088.en: Daye's expression is blank. He smiles at you and turns to leave, followed by only a long, lonely shadow under the setting sun.
10592088.ch: 大冶的神色一片木然，看不出情绪；他朝你微微一笑后便转身离开，斜阳下他的背影被拖得长长的，尤显凄凉孤独。

10592089.en: You see a cultivator standing face to face with {name|B}, trying to persuade him.
10592089.ch: 只见远方一名修仙者与{name|B}相对而立，这名修仙者似乎在极力说服他。

10592090.en: You should follow me. Such an aimless search will ruin you. It would be great if our sect have a knowledgeable person like you to take charge of our manuals!
10592090.ch: 你应该跟我走，你再这样瞎搞，只有断送了自己一生。你博览群书见识超卓，随我到宗门内管理秘籍，正是得其所哉！

10592091.en: And you could as well continue your search for the solutions to your trouble.
10592091.ch: 再说，这不也是一个让你继续查找根治你体质问题的好机会吗？

10592092.en: But I wouldn't be ambitious if I settled down. I'd... think about it.
10592092.ch: 你知道的，安定下来了，就再难保持这样的恒心了。我……再考虑一下。

10592093.en: Why are you so obsessed with changing your fate? We both know our effort in it would be in vain.
10592093.ch: 你为什么非要逆天而行？你我都知道这是改变不了的。

10592094.en: I must do it. I will do it. And I'll begin cultivation again, please go back. I found the new Qi refining method after many attempts, and I'll have a try.
10592094.ch: 这件事我一定要做，而且一定要做到。你回去吧，不要妨碍我修炼了，这可是我千辛万苦找到的练气的方法呢。

10592095.en: But how long will you practice it? To the end of your life?
10592095.ch: 你这样日积月累，打算练多久？练一辈子吗？

10592096.en: Yes. I'll not stop till my life ends.
10592096.ch: 是的，这辈子我无论如何也要做到。

10592097.en: You are as inflexible as a stone!

10592098.en: The cultivator walks away angrily, leaving only {name|B} on the mountain path. He gazes in the direction the person disappears with a helpless expression, but could only begin his practice again after adjusting his breath.
10592098.ch: 该修仙者拂袖而去，只留下{name|B}在山道之上。他目送此人时眼神中透出一股无奈，等到人走得远了便挠了挠头又再调匀呼吸继续拖拽重剑而行。

10592099.en: You enter the city and find {name|B} standing on a nearby hill and looking at the lively scene with a sigh.
10592099.ch: 你进入城中，只见{name|B}站在不远处的小丘上俯瞰前方景致，叹息着注视着城中的繁华景象。

10592100.en: This city has been a meeting place for cultivators throughout the land. It must be wonderful riding on an artifact and traveling in it.
10592100.ch: 这座城已成为一州修仙者落脚聚集的地方。看着他们每日里驾驭着法器穿梭来去，心中真是十分羡慕。

10592101.en: Do you think I could become one of them someday? Or if there is a possibility for me?
10592101.ch: 你说，我有朝一日也能成为他们之中的一员吗？我还有可能成为这样的人吗？

10592102.en: I always believe that I can overcome all difficulties. But to be honest, my Nil Root Constitution is...
10592102.ch: 坦白说，我曾经认为没有困难是我克服不了的。但这三阴绝脉体……

10592103.en: I tried so many methods, but I feel like my hope is fading. I am... a bit doubtful now.
10592103.ch: 试过的办法越来越多，希望也越来越渺茫了。我……不禁有些动摇。

10592104.en: Yes, I'm feeling extraordinarily bad now! Haha.
10592104.ch: 是的，我是非常人，现在也非常难受！哈哈。

10592105.en: Well, never mind my complaint. I'll make another try to cure it... perhaps.
10592105.ch: 我也就吐一下苦水，我应该会继续寻找方法根除三阴绝脉体的。

10592106.en: You're right. Even a sharp sword will get blunted from excessive use. Taking a rest is a fit preparation for the long way ahead.
10592106.ch: 嗯，你说得有道理，剑使钝了就该重新磨砺。休息一下才能再次上路，走得更远。

10592107.en: Give up... Maybe you're right. My life will be much easier after that. However, my character won't allow me to take such a decision.
10592107.ch: 放弃……确实，只要这么决定了，我就能轻松许多了。可是，我是那样的人吗？唉！

10592108.en: {name|B} sighs and looks into the distance again. His eyes gleam with a faint emotion, but you are uncertain whether it's sadness or desperation.
10592108.ch: {name|B}叹了口气后，再度目视远方，他眼中神光闪烁不定，你甚至辨别不出那究竟是难过还是心灰意懒。

10592109.en: You stumbled upon a man on your way. He carries a liquor pot and is walking unsteadily. You recognize he is {name|B} you saw before.
10592109.ch: 你走在路上，前方迎面走来一个手挽酒壶，脚步轻浮的男子。此人正是日前偶遇的{name|B}。

10592110.en: Hehe. Good liquor. Have a sip?
10592110.ch: 嘿嘿，这酒不错，要不要来一口？

10592111.en: Sober persons are usually haunted by absurd ideas. So, are they really sober at that time?
10592111.ch: 人醒着的时候总有许多不切实际的想法，到底是不是清醒那可难说得很啊。

10592112.en: Flee the ideas - stop thinking about them by getting myself drunk. Isn't it a wise choice? (Hiccup)
10592112.ch: 醉了、糊涂了，什么都不用想，难道不是更好吗？呃！（酒嗝）

10592113.en: I see, I see! Don't do harm to myself, yes? I always tell myself about it! And one more cup, right?
10592113.ch: 知道了，知道了！适可而止，对吧？我一直在跟自己说这话呢！先喝完这盅，啊？

10592114.en: {name|B} staggers away from your side. He seems to be heading to the tavern in Hua Feng's main city.
10592114.ch: {name|B}说完，摇摇晃晃的从你身边走过，似乎朝不远处华封州主城酒馆方向去了。

10592115.en: {name|B} is sitting beside a tavern window, watching what's happening outside. His face is ruddy, and you noticed a smell of alcohol around him. Maybe he is slightly drunk.
10592115.ch: {name|B}坐在酒馆窗边的座位上，拧着头看着外面。他面颊微红，身上散发着酒气，估计已是微醺之状态。

10592116.en: Hey, you're here? Here, have a drink! In one gulp!
10592116.ch: 呀，是你？来,喝一杯！要一口干了！

10592117.en: Good! Alas, do you see the clouds? Is it going to rain?
10592117.ch: 好！唉，天上云层很厚，这是要下雨了吧？

10592118.en: A thunderclap comes from high above just as {name|B} finished speaking. The next moment, raindrops hit the ground in an incessant splatting sound amid occasional rumbles, covering the world under a heavy curtain of rain.
10592118.ch: {name|B}说完这话，外面果然传来一声雷鸣。轰隆声中，豆大的水滴洒落地面，发出哗啦啦的响。只一瞬间，外面雨下如注，放眼看去八荒大地仿佛笼罩在一片帘幕之中。

10592120.en: Thanks for being here by my side. I'm feeling much better.
10592120.ch: 多谢你能来陪我一会，我好多了。

10592121.en: {name|B} drinks another several cups and takes a deep breath. Finally, he stands up and staggers out of the tavern.
10592121.ch: {name|B}闷着头又喝了几杯，终于深深的吸了口气，重新站起，摇摇晃晃的走出了酒馆。

10592122.en: Yes, I cannot give up! I'll never be able to stand up again once I fall here today.
10592122.ch: 是的，我不能放弃！如果我今天倒了，以后就再也站不起来了。

10592123.en: {name|B} leaves the seat and reels out of the tavern into the rain.
10592123.ch: {name|B}直起身来，摇摇晃晃的走出了酒馆，消失在雨幕之中。

10592124.en: What am I doing? I don't even know what am I doing!
10592124.ch: 我在干什么？我也不知道自己在干什么！

10592125.en: I want to cure the Nil Root Constitution, and now am I succeeded in it?
10592125.ch: 我只想摆脱三阴绝脉体，可到头来我做到了吗？

10592126.en: {name|B} leans down on the table motionlessly. But the next moment, you see him supporting himself to stand up again with the arms. He then walks out of the tavern in unsteady steps.
10592126.ch: {name|B}头一歪就倒桌上一动不动，但只过了片刻，他便已用双手支在桌面上，重新站了起来摇摇晃晃的走了出去。

10592127.en: Thanks for listening to my complaints. I'll keep going...
10592127.ch: 多谢你来听我发牢骚。我不会放弃的……

10592128.en: You see {name|B} is standing on the hill near his residence. He is looking into the distance, but his eyes are clear. The sadness you noticed in him before is gone.
10592128.ch: 只见{name|B}在自己家中附近的山冈上登高远眺，他眼中一片澄澈，之前目光中的阴翳早已一扫而空。

10592129.en: Greetings. I'm still on my way to find a remedy, but all my effort is in vain. To be honest, I feel a bit frustrated.
10592129.ch: 你来啦？我一直希望能找到办法根治我体质问题，却总是无法实现。说实话，我已经有点气馁了。

10592130.en: Thank you. The cure is not in Hua Feng, but I may find it in Yun Mo.
10592130.ch: 多谢你的鼓励。其实在华封州中找不到根治的办法，不代表云陌州没有。

10592131.en: So I decided to go to Yun Mo. The journey there will be much more difficult, but I cannot let the chance slip.
10592131.ch: 所以我决定前往云陌州去继续找法子，无论多困难我也要找到！

10592132.en: I'll set out soon, and now I'd like to bid you goodbye. Thanks for visiting me here.
10592132.ch: 我这就要启程了，正好与你道别。多谢你来看望我呢。

10592133.en: But I don't want to be resigned now. I'll find a way to correct my spiritual roots at all costs!
10592133.ch: 不过我还是不服气。我无论如何也要找到根治我灵根的办法的！

10592134.en: Now I'll set out to Yun Mo. I found nothing in Hua Feng, but maybe the remedy to my constitution hides in my next destination.
10592134.ch: 如今我决定前往云陌州。虽说华封州中找不到根治的办法，没准云陌州就有了呢。

10592135.en: I'll leave soon. Hope you could visit me there!
10592135.ch: 我这就准备启程，有空可要多来看望我啊！

10592136.en: {name|A}, I need your help, please come here quickly!

10592137.en: I went into the hills for a Purple Essence Flower with ten petals, since I heard that such a plant may help me in restoring my spiritual roots. However, I stumbled upon a wounded cultivator here.
10592137.ch: 我原本是出来寻找据说能恢复灵根的十瓣紫元花的。我在山中寻觅，没发现灵物，却找到一名受伤遭困的修仙者。

10592138.en: Now the cultivator is unable to move due to injury, and I could not tend to the wounds. I'm afraid the person will perish if we do not offer help!
10592138.ch: 如今他行动不便，我又无法为其疗伤，若任由其暴露在野外，恐怕会有不测！

10592139.en: He's not far from me. Let's hurry up!
10592139.ch: 他就在前方不远，我们快过去！

10592140.en: Following {name|B}'s guide, you find the wounded cultivator. You see the person is supporting himself against a cliff, surrounded by ferocious monsters. He is in imminent peril.
10592140.ch: 你在{name|B}的指引下，找到受困的修仙者，其时他依在山壁上，周围若干妖兽围堵，眼看情势已经十分危险。

10592141.en: It's so frightening... Hope I didn't leave for too long.

10592142.en: Thank you. I was too careless and got myself injured and cornered here. You and your companion's generous assistance saved me from the monster's jaws.
10592142.ch: 多谢你。我太大意了，竟在这山中受伤，还遭妖物围堵。若非你将我救到此处，又离开找来这位道友帮忙，恐怕我已成妖兽的裹腹物了。

10592143.en: But I noticed that... you seem to have only shallow cultivation. Would you like to tell me why are you here?
10592143.ch: 对了，你修为……似乎不高，何以冒险进入此处山间。

10592144.en: Because of my Nil Root Constitution. I come here for the Purple Essence Flower since I heard that the plant with ten petals may be useful in restoring my spiritual roots.
10592144.ch: 我是三阴绝脉体质，因此来寻十瓣紫元花，希望借此恢复自己的灵根。

10592145.en: I see... There used to be a lot of the flowers a century ago, but most of them had only five or six petals possibly due to Nether Air. Besides, the Purple Essence Flower has never been seen by our contemporaries, and I'm afraid that it has become extinct.
10592145.ch: 这样么，其实此地百年前还孕育大量紫元花，其后似乎因为冥气之故，紫元花仅得五瓣六瓣，近年更是凋零绝迹。只怕你要失望了。

10592146.en: Well... The plant has become extinct? Oh, no...
10592146.ch: 啊……紫元花已经灭绝了吗？唉……

10592147.en: Cheer up, my friend. You saved my life, and I'll repay your favor. I'll try my best to find the plant for you. Please don't give up.
10592147.ch: 朋友不必灰心，你的救命之恩，我永存心中，此后亦必设法为你寻找此物。请你万勿气馁。

10592149.en: Oh, well! I'm just... in low spirits. I'm not going to give up now. Thanks for your warm words!
10592149.ch: 啊？是！我就是……多少有些失望。不过我不会气馁的，多谢你的鼓励！

10592150.en: And fellow cultivator, thanks for saving me as well. Here, you may take these as my gratitude.
10592150.ch: 道友，此番生还，亦赖你驱逐妖兽。救命之恩，无以为报。这里小小心意，希望你不要嫌弃。

10592151.en: You see a man walking toward you as you enter the city. He is {name|B} you met before in Hua Feng, and you remembered his Nil Root Constitution.
10592151.ch: 你刚进入城中，不料迎面走来一名男子，却是之前在华封州中认识的身怀三阴绝脉体的{name|B}。

10592153.en: Sigh. I have come to Yun Mo for some days, but I found nothing.
10592153.ch: 唉，来到云陌州已经有些日子了，仍是一无所获。

10592154.en: Perhaps it is a trial, I guess. Maybe I'll feel disappointed or frustrated again and again, but I'll never give up. Never!
10592154.ch: 这应该是对我的考验吧？我可能还会沮丧，还会不开心，但我绝对不会放弃。一定！

10592155.en: I'm living near <r>the main city of Yun Mo</r> now. See you!
10592155.ch: 我目前在<r>云陌州主城附近暂住</r>，有缘再会吧！

10592156.en: Well. I'll continue my search for the cure to my constitution. I'm living near <r>the main city of Yun Mo</r> now, and you could visit me there.
10592156.ch: 嗯，我得继续寻找排除三阴绝脉体的法子了，我目前<r>在云陌州主城附近暂住</r>，有空过来小聚吧？

10592157.en: You hear a shout for help comes from the distance...
10592157.ch: 只听得远方传来求救之声……

10592160.en: I read from ancient books that the place holds a treasure. It is a piece of jade that could affect its wearer's fate, so I came here for it.
10592160.ch: 是这样的，我翻查了许多古籍，发现此地藏有上古宝玉，据说此物带在身上即能改变运数，是十分难得的秘宝！

10592161.en: I entered a ruin in the deep ground and found the jade. However, the ruin then crumbled down and trapped me inside for three whole days. I almost died in it!
10592161.ch: 我在地底发现一处遗迹，并从中找到了这片宝玉。恰逢此地崩裂损坏，我被困在里面三日三夜，差点就要完了。凶险啊！

10592162.en: Sure! I finally find the remedy for my troublesome constitution, and let's see how the jade will help me!
10592162.ch: 是！太好了！我找到的这枚玉佩，据传可以改变任何体质，这次有救了。

10592163.en: A group of villagers walks to you while {name|B} is chatting with you merrily. They noticed the jade in {name|B}'s hands.
10592163.ch: {name|B}正觉欢喜，此时前方来了一些村民，他们目光纷纷落在{name|B}手中佩玉上。

10592164.en: Finally, our last hope against disasters!

10592166.en: Senior cultivator, we're the descendants of the water managers who worked under Yu centuries ago. Today we still station in crucial places against potential floods.
10592166.ch: 仙长，我等先祖原是上古治水神工大禹手下的水工，时移世易，仍在某些重要节点镇守。免得有朝一日洪水再临。

10592167.en: The jade in your hands is named River Ballast and is an artifact used for calming the Feng Shui in mountains and hills.
10592167.ch: 您手中佩玉名为“镇川”，乃是一块镇住山陵风水的法宝。

10592168.en: Legends said that an ancient cultivator found it but refused to hand it over. What's more, the cultivator hid the jade in a secluded place to keep it from others' sight. Therefore, the Feng Shui in nearby hills are wilting these years, and soon a disaster will fall upon us if the situation continues to worsen.
10592168.ch: 听闻古时此物为一名修仙者所得，他拒绝交出佩玉，临死前还将之收藏在一个极为隐秘的地方。因此近年来附近山陵风水衰变，情况十分凶险。

10592169.en: We have searched for it for many years, but we didn't expect that it would be in your hands, senior cultivator.
10592169.ch: 我等寻觅多年，都不曾找到，没料却被仙长你寻得。

10592170.en: Senior cultivator, this is our cherished artifact used for keeping the Feng Shui here undisturbed. Would you mind handing over it to me?
10592170.ch: 仙长，此物乃镇住一方地脉风水的法器，可否交予老朽保管？

10592171.en: {name|B} seems doubtful at first hearing it. Then, he begins to ponder after looking at the villagers for a long time.
10592171.ch: {name|B}听了这话，先露出了狐疑之色。他打量对方良久后，不禁沉吟起来。

10592172.en: The fate of our entire world is, after all, more important than mine... And if so, I couldn't keep it for my own use.
10592172.ch: 我个人遭际和八荒命运相比，终究太过渺小……我不能独占此物……

10592173.en: Village head, if you found it useful, then please take it.
10592173.ch: 村长，此物便交给你保管使用吧。

10592174.en: Thank you, senior cultivator! Your deed will benefit our water managers as well as the world!
10592174.ch: 多谢仙长，这是我等水工之福，苍生之福！

10592175.en: The water manager takes the jade from {name|B} with both hands and bids goodbye to him after expressing much gratitude.
10592175.ch: 水工恭恭敬敬接过了{name|B}手中佩玉，再连番致谢，这才道别离去。

10592176.en: Sigh. Will a second River Ballast be waiting for me?
10592176.ch: 唉，你说，天底下还有另外一块“镇川”吗？

10592177.en: {name|B} begins to ponder again. You noticed a hint of disappointment and sadness in his eyes.
10592177.ch: {name|B}说完又再思索起来，神情间却透出一阵失望与悲伤。

10592178.en: You're right. The jade must be much more useful if it could placate the Feng Shui of the land. Therefore, keeping the treasure my own as its previous owner did would be too selfish.
10592178.ch: 正有此意。毕竟事关地脉风水，影响深远。我岂能似那人一般自私自利，将法器藏了起来呢？

10592182.en: My effort comes to nothing again...

10592184.en: Tavern keeper, have you found anything on the matter I asked you half a year ago?
10592184.ch: 老板，半年前拜托你帮忙打听的事有着落了吗？

10592185.en: Yes. I found something after many inquiries.
10592185.ch: 嗯，我多方打听终于有着落了。

10592186.en: Oh?! Then the legends are true! The place exists, and so does the cure to my Nil Root Constitution!
10592186.ch: 啊！？那么就是说，真的有那个地方，真的有治愈灵根，改变三阴绝脉体的方法？！

10592189.en: Eh... The place you asked about locates in the deepest ground and is accessible only from a secret path. However, Nether Air seeped into it and blocked living beings from entering now.
10592189.ch: 这个……那个地方深处地底，有幽径直通。但现如今，已经遭到冥气入侵，无法进入了。

10592191.en: Hey, you good-for-nothing. Why do you seem so crestfallen? I made so many searches and told my findings to the boss because I was moved by your perseverance.
10592191.ch: 小废物，露出这难看的表情是几个意思？我可是看着你一直不放弃的份上这才多方查探，并将这个消息告诉老板的。

10592192.en: And I even made an expedition myself, for fear that you would venture there out of overconfidence. I caught a hint of Nether Air in it and had to rest till now because of that! And how dare you repay me with such an expression?
10592192.ch: 我怕你这小垃圾又不自量力贸然进入那个地方，所以给你探过路了。结果吸入了一丝冥气，还为此躺了半年呢。你就用这垂头丧气的模样回报我吗？

10592193.en: Why are you in low spirits?! I and our old friends in the tavern are all worrying about you. Please keep going.
10592193.ch: 你为什么看起来很泄气？！我这酒馆中都是老相识，都很担心你的。你可不能这样放弃啊。

10592194.en: Well... Yes, I'll keep going perhaps... Thank you, and thank you all...
10592194.ch: 我……我不会的，多谢你们……多谢大家……

10592195.en: Hearing {name|B}'s words, the persons around began to encourage him with their warm words. {name|B} thanked for their kindness and left the tavern hastily, and when you find him again, he is staring into the distance blankly in a secluded place, apparently lost in thought.
10592195.ch: 这些酒客听到{name|B}这样说，都纷纷为他打气。{name|B}一一道谢后，这才匆匆离开酒馆，站在一个无人的地方静静的看着远方发呆。

10592196.en: Well, you have seen it all? I... I'm fine.
10592196.ch: 啊？刚刚的事你都看见了？我，我没事的。

10592197.en: The guys in the tavern are eager to help me, and I'm glad to meet them, as well as you, again!
10592197.ch: 酒馆的朋友都是真心帮助我的，我很庆幸还能遇见这些人，当然，还有你！

10592198.en: I'm fine. No need to worry me. I said I won't give up!
10592198.ch: 我真的没事，不用担心。我不会放弃的！

10592199.en: {name|B} seems preoccupied recently. You noticed his expression is unusually serious - perhaps he is planning something.
10592199.ch: {name|B}近日总是神不守舍，他的神情或凝重或紧张，似乎正在考虑着什么重要事情的样子。

10592200.en: I'm still trying to cure my Nil Root Constitution. A method impressed me a lot before, but it is very risky. I'm hesitating about that.
10592200.ch: 我只是在想办法根除三阴绝脉体而已。之前一直有个办法是我很想尝试的，但这办法终究有点凶险。我在想要不要去试试？

10592201.en: The place is said to be a crucial point in forming the land we're on, and maybe it could reshape my body as well.
10592201.ch: 那个地方据传以前就是塑造一方大陆的关键枢纽，没准能为我重新塑造身体。

10592202.en: But I'm just imagining. It does not welcome ordinary visitors.
10592202.ch: 不过我也就想想而已，这个地方毕竟寻常人是无法接近的。

10592203.en: {name|B} speaks confusingly and walks away slowly.
10592203.ch: {name|B}语无伦次的说了一通后便转过头慢慢离开了。

10592204.en: There is no one in the room. Several desks are arranged haphazardly, laden with piles of manuals as well as notes taken from them. You also noticed a piece of paper on the top of the books. It reads "Supreme Forge".
10592204.ch: 房屋中已空无一人，只有几张书案无序地搁在里面，上面放满了修炼秘籍，旁边还有大量阅读心得。这些书籍上还放着一张白纸，上面赫然写着大冶台三字。

10592206.en: You see a map on the paper. It marks out a location named Supreme Forge, with a winding path leading to it.
10592206.ch: 白纸上画着一幅地图，上面标明一个叫做“大冶台”的地点。另外还画着一条弯弯曲曲的路线图。

10592208.en: You come to the place indicated on the map. The Supreme Forge is unknown to most people and is apparently dangerous. Glowing lava gushes out from everywhere, while at the same time, bluish ice continues to form amid the searing heat.
10592208.ch: 你依照地图所示来到名为大冶台的地点。这个隐秘的地方里面四处岩浆喷涌，明明热浪炙人，但里面仍不断生成幽蓝色的坚冰。此地一看而知乃是一个凶险之地。

10592209.en: You venture into its depth and see a hill crack before you. Its crater spits out lava into the air, and soon, a scorching rain falls down. The lava drops melt everything covered by them before cooling down, then reshaping them into different forms.
10592209.ch: 你避过种种凶险来到大冶台深处，只见前方一处山体崩裂，当中喷出岩浆，直冲半空，继而星霰而下。周围的东西为岩浆融化消解，冷却之后化生各种形态。

10592210.en: To your surprise, you find a remnant of clothing swaying on the tip of a sharp stone. The extreme heat eventually lights it; flame begins to emerge on its rim. Soon, the fabric scrap is consumed by fire, and the ember is carried away and scattered into the air by a torrid wind.
10592210.ch: 而这个恐怖的地方之中赫然有一角衣衫碎片挂在山壁尖石处。这半截衣衫不耐台上高热，渐渐自燃，随即被一股卷来的热浪吹至半天，化为漫天余烬。

10592212.en: You see {name|B} is stepping on the stone walkway of a cliff. The road ahead has already been destroyed, and all there remains are but a few protruding stubs. He would fall with even one little misstep.
10592212.ch: 只见{name|B}正站在山边石栈之上，前方道路已然坍塌，剩余山壁断口，仍有一点位置可供踩踏，然而若冒险前进，稍不注意，即会失足跌落。

10592213.en: I heard that some spiritual plant is growing on the mountain's top, and I want to find it.
10592213.ch: 听说这处峰顶长有灵物，我想要上去一探。

10592214.en: I have reached an agreement with the manager of the Manual Pavilion. If I found the stuff for him, he would sneak into the library and search for the cure to my constitution.
10592214.ch: 我与琅琊阁的主管说好了，只要我找到那个灵物送给他，他愿意偷偷打开库存为我查探根治三阴绝脉体的方法。

10592215.en: But the stone slabs before me are broken. It would be hard for me... to walk on them...
10592215.ch: 不过这路塌了，要走过去……还是挺艰难的……

10592216.en: You support yourself against the cliff and walk before him. {name|B} is astonished by your motion, but after only a few seconds, he begins to move slowly on the walkway with much caution.
10592216.ch: 你背靠山壁，迈开步伐，小心翼翼走在前方。{name|B}见状惊愕交加。不过他只呆了片刻便鼓起勇气，学着你慢慢在断壁上移动。
